The structure of Cs2InAsS4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms (Cs8 In4 As4 S16) distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As and In each coordinated by four S neighbors, while Cs adopts an 8-neighbor body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement of S atoms. Polyhedral sharing between Cs and S polyhedra includes corner- and edge-sharing, and Cs–Cs polyhedra share edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 36 sites.
